# Known reader fixtures

Created for Borges, with no third-party book content. The generated prose, documents, and coral image may be used under CC0-1.0. Recreate with `uv run --no-project python scripts/create-fixtures.py` after the locked JavaScript installation. The generator uses only Python's standard library and fixed ZIP timestamps.

- `known.pdf`: three physical pages with independent markers ORCHID FIRST, CEDAR SECOND, HARBOR THIRD; each has a 24×24 RGB(224,80,48) image drawn as a square and two occurrences of “lantern”. A Harbor outline destination targets page 3; a link over the first title targets page 2.
- `image-only.pdf`: a single page with that image and no text objects; represents the image-only/scanned rendering case, not a scanned external work.
- `reflowable.epub`: two chapters, ORCHID EPUB FIRST and HARBOR EPUB SECOND, navigation document and local coral image. The first chapter also has 40 numbered LANTERN PASSAGE paragraphs, each with independently known text, for multi-page font/resize/resume tests.
- `fixed.epub`: same known content in two 400×500 fixed-layout pages. Publisher requests spreads; the adapter must still show one page.
- `malicious.epub`: derived from the created obfuscated-font fixture, with inline/manifest/remote scripts, event handlers, nested/scripted SVG, remote image/CSS/font references and connection hints, a control-character JavaScript URL, file/traversal URLs, embedded frames/objects, refresh/base elements, external/data/mail/download links and a form. Native tests substitute its bytes for the allowlisted diagnostic EPUB; no arbitrary-file loader is added. Local image/font rendering and search after sanitization remain positive controls.
- `obfuscated.epub`: same reflowable content using the Liberation Sans Regular font shipped in pinned PDF.js, IDPF font obfuscation with the declared publication identifier. See `LICENSE_LIBERATION` for the font's SIL Open Font License and copyrights. No DRM credentials are needed.

The native checks independently assert the first markers, decoded PDF image pixel, EPUB image dimensions/visibility, a single loaded chapter frame, and the actual loaded font face. Interaction checks use the second/third PDF markers, known links/outlines, repeated match offsets, the EPUB chapter markers and LANTERN PASSAGE 24 in actual selected/visible ranges. Snapshots are written by the test harness and restored explicitly after real process restarts; this does not prove application autosave. Five isolation scenarios also exercise real protocol/filesystem symlinks, a controlled HTTP endpoint, navigation, and forged/replayed message attempts. These deliberately tiny fixtures do not replace a varied reader corpus or catalog-backed stale-write tests.
